reason: The 08-25 acceptance of player ban reasons is real and the 09-03 Jira 'cut' rationale cites only 08-18. (Lina, line 312), 'So if these are good like we can start with these again like we can always change them up later too.' (Kobi) and 'Perfect.' q2: Supports the claim. 08-25 at 00:17:10: Kobi opens the mockup ban reasons and says 'This is for player'. Lina says 'I think it looks fine'. Emily asks one question about duplicate accounts, then accepts ('Perfect'). Kobi: 'we can start with these ones for Ben [ban]'. Then the discussion moves on to referrer ban reasons, where Lina asks to add 'associated with fraud network'. This is a client acceptance, not just a proposal. Speakers are correct. 09-01 at 00:10:11: an internal Kobi/Taryn decision to build the player ban from the mockup values, matching the referrer ban. It is not clearly about a ban-reason picklist, so the Jira 09-03 reading of it as 'ban reasons cut' is weak. This supports the variance.
q3: No later client meeting explicitly reverses or confirms the 08-25 decision. 09-15 (L2588-L2590): Emily asked in writing whether a reason code is needed. Taryn's notes say 'no reason'. Kobi does not remember, and Taryn will send Emily the call link. 09-17 (L2669, L2686, L2687): still open internally; Kobi says players 'are gonna need to know why the player was banned'. 09-23 (L2856, raw transcript line ~380): the fraud and email banners are dropped, per Taryn second-hand. Taryn reminded Emily that the ban banner covers the broad case. WAGR-403 comment (Taryn, 2026-09-22) records Emily's written reply: the existing Banned Banner is sufficient, 'no need to bring back Ban Reason'. This is client acceptance of no ban reason, but second-hand and given in the context of the fraud banner. No ledger items after 09-23 on player ban reasons.
q4: Partly covered. The WAGR-154 and WAGR-156 comments (2026-09-03, both 2 comments total) state that player Ban Reason/Notes were cut. Their rationale cites only 08-18 and does not mention the 08-25 acceptance. The WAGR-154 description (Summary, Proposed solution step 1 'requires Ban_Reason__c', AC1 'Ban action requires a reason') still conflicts with those comments. The WAGR-156 description still lists the Ban modal reason picklist as an open question. The WAGR-403 comment (2026-09-22) records Emily's written acceptance of no Ban Reason. Jira does not reconcile the WAGR-154 AC with the decision.
corrections: The WAGR-154/156 cut comments have no author in the API, but Kobi Kunasekaran attached the screenshots minutes earlier on 2026-09-03.
The 'later' evidence item L1980 (08-18) is EARLIER than the 08-25 acceptance, not later.

WAGR-403 records the client's 22 Sep written reply ('no need to bring back Ban Reason'). This is more than a passing second-hand mention, and it weakens the need for a new client ask. Suggested action: update the WAGR-154 description and AC1 to 'no reason' and record the 08-25 vs 22 Sep history. Get explicit client confirmation only if Jumpr wants it first-hand.
